# Your Bali Getaway (YBG Villas)

> Your Bali Getaway is a collection of five private-pool villas in Seminyak, Bali, booked direct with the host. No platform fees, best-rate guarantee, and instant WhatsApp confirmation. Real-time availability is powered by Hostaway.

Location: Seminyak, Bali, Indonesia
Contact: +62 822-2176-2980 / yourbaligetaway.bali@gmail.com
Booking model: Direct with the host (no online travel agency fees)

## Villas

- [Bali Bliss](https://www.yourbaligetaway.com/villas/bali-bliss): cheerful 2-bedroom private-pool villa, a short walk from Seminyak Beach and Kayu Aya "Eat Street".
- [Bali Blue 1](https://www.yourbaligetaway.com/villas/bali-blue-1): peaceful 2-bedroom pool villa with a master suite and bathtub, steps from Kayu Aya "Eat Street".
- [Bali Blue 2](https://www.yourbaligetaway.com/villas/bali-blue-2): relaxed 2-bedroom private-pool villa with a lush tropical garden in central Seminyak.
- [Bali Green](https://www.yourbaligetaway.com/villas/bali-green): spacious 4-bedroom private-pool villa near Double Six Beach, ideal for groups and families.
- [Bali Sol](https://www.yourbaligetaway.com/villas/bali-sol): exceptionally spacious 2-bedroom villa with a private pool and home cinema in central Seminyak.
